title: Helping a Stranger Without Expecting Thanks
paragraphs: Saat pulang larut malam, Yumna melihat seorang pengemudi dengan ban kempes di jalan yang sepi. Ia berhenti pada jarak aman dan menghubungi layanan bantuan jalan. Ia tetap berada di mobilnya yang terkunci sampai bantuan datang. Ia juga memberikan nomor telepon layanan itu dan memastikan pengemudi dapat menghubungi keluarganya.

Seminggu kemudian, Yumna melihat artikel lokal tentang seseorang yang membantu malam itu secara anonim. Ia mengenali kisahnya, tetapi tidak menceritakan perannya. Ia berkata kepada teman dekatnya bahwa membantu dengan diam-diam terasa lebih tulus. Bagi Yumna, yang penting orang itu sampai pada keadaan aman.
answerKey: Driving home late one night, Yumna saw a driver with a flat tire on a quiet road. She stopped at a safe distance and called roadside assistance. She stayed in her locked car nearby until help arrived. She also gave the driver the phone number and made sure he could call a family member. A week later, Yumna saw a local article about an anonymous person who had helped that night. She recognized the story but did not mention her role. She told a close friend that helping quietly felt more sincere. For Yumna, the important thing was that someone reached safety.
